Coal ore: 5 World XP.
Iron or copper ore: 10 World XP.
Gold, redstone, or lapis ore: 15 World XP.
Diamond or emerald ore: 50 World XP.
Natural logs: 3 World XP.
Tagged crops: 2 World XP.
Creative and spectator players do not receive this direct gathering XP. Blocks recorded as player-placed are excluded to prevent farming the same ore, log, or crop block repeatedly.

Every positive vanilla XP award outside the mod's mob-kill context becomes World XP at 10 times its final amount. This captures ore orbs, furnace output, fishing, breeding, trading, crop-rune XP, and other ordinary XP sources.

Experience Bonus increases an XP amount before combat/non-combat routing.
Mining Experience spawns extra ore/block XP equal to base orb size x bonus near the closest player within 8 blocks.
Breeding Experience spawns floor(7 x bonus) extra XP for the loving player.
Fishing Experience spawns floor(catch result x 3 x bonus) extra XP.
Those bonus orbs are non-combat XP, so collecting them sends their final value to the World Tree at the normal 10x conversion.
